name: Breathing / HRV
description: Breathing exercise to regulate the nervous system and improve rider-horse connection.
instructions: Place your horse and yourself in a safe, low-demand context (halt or easy walk) before starting this tool.

Follow this focus: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Inhale 4, exhale 6 — 6–8 cycles. Say it: ‘Rhythm before results.’.  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breaths/strides, then return to normal riding and briefly notice what feels different.
evidence_base: Heart rate variability (HRV) research, respiratory sinus arrhythmia, autonomic regulation studies, and breathwork for performance.
